extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Lee County has a $40 monthly premium, a $520 drug deductible and a $6500 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed the required steps by delivering the disclaimer before discussing plan benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. However, the agent should avoid asking for Medicare numbers and dates of birth during the call to prevent PII exposure.
composition.coaching_note: During the call, the agent asked for the customer's Medicare number and date of birth, which is not recommended as it exposes sensitive information. Next time, ensure to avoid collecting such information until after the appointment is signed.

crm_record.next_step: Review plan with customer and schedule follow-up
